title: giteasy
description: Plain-English git via MCP: 22 tools to branch, commit, push, and tag. No git jargon.
summary: Plain-English git via MCP: 22 tools to branch, commit, push, and tag. No git jargon.
offersHint: Plain-English git via MCP: 22 tools to branch, commit, push, and tag. No git jargon. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://giteasy-mcp.azurewebsites.net/mcp

toolsPreview.name: push
toolsPreview.description: Send already-committed work to the remote without making a new commit. Pushes the current branch; on a branch's first push, sets the remote branch as its upstream automatically.

toolsPreview.name: show_diagnostic
toolsPreview.description: Show git repository diagnostic info: current branch, upstream, HEAD SHA, remote URLs, and status summary.

toolsPreview.name: set_vault
toolsPreview.description: Configure the git credential helper to use a specific vault path. Returns new credential helper value.

toolsPreview.name: restore_file
toolsPreview.description: Restore a single file to its HEAD state, discarding uncommitted changes. Returns restored file path.

toolsPreview.name: reset_login
toolsPreview.description: Clear stored git credentials by unsetting the credential helper in local git config. Returns confirmation.

toolsPreview.name: set_ssh
toolsPreview.description: Change a remote URL to its SSH equivalent. Returns old and new remote URLs.

toolsPreview.name: save_work
toolsPreview.description: Stage changes, commit with a message, and optionally push to remote. Returns commit SHA and push result.

toolsPreview.name: get_vault_status
toolsPreview.description: Report current git credential helper configuration. Returns helper name and scope.

toolsPreview.name: test_login
toolsPreview.description: Test whether git credentials are working by attempting ls-remote against the origin. Returns success/failure and remote refs count.

toolsPreview.name: show_releases
toolsPreview.description: List all tags/releases in the repository, newest first. Returns tag names, target SHAs, and annotation messages.

toolsPreview.name: show_change
toolsPreview.description: Show the diff for a specific file or all changed files. Returns unified diff text.

toolsPreview.name: new_release
toolsPreview.description: Create an annotated git tag and push it to the remote. Returns the tag name and target commit SHA.

toolsPreview.name: find_changes
toolsPreview.description: List changed files: staged, unstaged, and untracked. Returns file counts and paths by status group.

toolsPreview.name: show_remote
toolsPreview.description: Show all remote names and their fetch/push URLs. Returns list of remotes with URL and type.

toolsPreview.name: get_updates
toolsPreview.description: Fetch from remote and show incoming commits not yet in local branch. Returns count and commit summaries.

toolsPreview.name: undo_changes
toolsPreview.description: Discard uncommitted changes. If filePath given, restores that file; otherwise restores all tracked files. Returns list of restored paths.

toolsPreview.name: switch_work
toolsPreview.description: Switch to an existing branch. Returns the branch switched to and current HEAD SHA.

toolsPreview.name: search_history
toolsPreview.description: Search commit history for commits whose message matches a search term. Returns matching commits with SHA, author, date, and message.

toolsPreview.name: show_history
toolsPreview.description: Show recent commit history. Returns commits with SHA, author, date, and message.

toolsPreview.name: new_work_branch
toolsPreview.description: Create a new branch from current HEAD and switch to it. Returns branch name and base commit SHA.

toolsPreview.name: set_token
toolsPreview.description: Store a personal access token for HTTP git authentication. Returns confirmation (token value is never echoed).

toolsPreview.name: clear_junk
toolsPreview.description: Remove untracked files and directories from the working tree (git clean -fd). Returns list of removed paths.
